**Algorithm 1. Pathwise exact Huber CD with an MM scale update.**
Blue expressions mark changes from ROME. Set $\chi=0$ for fixed scale and
$\chi=1$ for concomitant estimation.

| Line | Instruction |
|--:|:--|
| 1 | **Input:** $X,y,\lambda_1\ge\cdots\ge\lambda_L>0,\rho,\sigma^{(0)},\epsilon>0,K\in\mathbb N_+$; [$a>0,B\in\mathbb N_+,\chi\in\{0,1\}$.]{.addition} |
| 2 | $\widehat\beta_0\leftarrow0,\quad\widehat\sigma_0\leftarrow\sigma^{(0)}$. |
| 3 | **For** $\ell=1,\ldots,L$ **do** |
| 4 | $\beta\leftarrow\widehat\beta_{\ell-1},\quad r\leftarrow y-X\beta,\quad\sigma\leftarrow\widehat\sigma_{\ell-1}$. |
| 5 | **For** $k=1,\ldots,K$ **do** |
| 6 | [**If** $\chi=1$ **then**]{.addition} |
| 7 | [**If** $r=0$ **or** $2na\ge\rho^2\#\{i:r_i\ne0\}$: **return** $((\widehat\beta_m,\widehat\sigma_m,\kappa_m)_{m<\ell},(\beta,0,0))$.]{.addition} |
| 8 | [**For** $b=1,\ldots,B$: $\sigma\leftarrow\{(2an)^{-1}\sum_i\min(r_i^2,\rho^2\sigma^2)\}^{1/2}$; **end for; end if**.]{.addition} |
| 9 | [$\delta\leftarrow\rho\sigma,\quad\eta\leftarrow\sigma\lambda_\ell$.]{.addition} |
| 10 | [$E\leftarrow\{j:\beta_j\ne0\}\cup\{j:|X_j^\top\psi_\delta(r)/n|>\eta\}$.]{.addition} |
| 11 | **For** $j\in E$, in increasing order, **do** |
| 12 | $u\leftarrow r+X_j\beta_j,\quad\beta_j^-\leftarrow\beta_j$. |
| 13 | $\beta_j\leftarrow\mathrm{ExactHuberCoordinate}(u,X_j,\delta,\eta)$. |
| 14 | $r\leftarrow r-X_j(\beta_j-\beta_j^-)$; **end for**. |
| 15 | $v_\beta\leftarrow R_\beta(\beta,r,\sigma,\lambda_\ell)$; [$v_\sigma\leftarrow\chi R_\sigma(r,\sigma)$.]{.addition} |
| 16 | **If** $\max(v_\beta,v_\sigma)\le\epsilon$: **break**; **end for**. |
| 17 | $\widehat\beta_\ell\leftarrow\beta$; [$\widehat\sigma_\ell\leftarrow\sigma$]{.addition}; $\kappa_\ell\leftarrow\mathbf1_{\{\max(v_\beta,v_\sigma)\le\epsilon\}}$. |
| 18 | **If** $\kappa_\ell=0$: **return** $(\widehat\beta_m,\widehat\sigma_m,\kappa_m)_{m=1}^{\ell}$; **end for**. |
| 19 | **Return** $(\widehat\beta_\ell,\widehat\sigma_\ell,\kappa_\ell)_{\ell=1}^L$. |

**Algorithm 2.** $\mathrm{ExactHuberCoordinate}(u,x,\delta,\eta)$.

| Line | Instruction |
|--:|:--|
| 1 | **Input:** $u,x\in\mathbb R^n,\ \delta>0,\ \eta\ge0$. |
| 2 | $g_0\leftarrow-n^{-1}\sum_i x_i\mathrm{sign}(u_i)\min\{|u_i|,\delta\}$. |
| 3 | **If** $|g_0|\le\eta$: **return** $0$. |
| 4 | $d\leftarrow-\mathrm{sign}(g_0),\quad D\leftarrow dg_0+\eta,\quad c\leftarrow0,\quad I\leftarrow\{i:x_i\ne0\}$. |
| 5 | **For** $i\in I$: $w_i\leftarrow x_i^2/n,\quad a_i\leftarrow u_i/(dx_i)-\delta/|x_i|,\quad b_i\leftarrow u_i/(dx_i)+\delta/|x_i|$; **end for**. |
| 6 | $S\leftarrow\sum_{i\in I}w_i\mathbf1_{\{a_i\le0<b_i\}}$. |
| 7 | $\{v_1<\cdots<v_M\}\leftarrow(\{a_i:i\in I\}\cup\{b_i:i\in I\})\cap(0,\infty)$. |
| 8 | **For** $m=1,\ldots,M$ **do** |
| 9 | $J_m\leftarrow\sum_{i\in I}w_i(\mathbf1_{\{a_i=v_m\}}-\mathbf1_{\{b_i=v_m\}})$. |
| 10 | **If** $S>0$ **and** $D+S(v_m-c)\ge0$: **return** $d(c-D/S)$. |
| 11 | $D\leftarrow D+S(v_m-c),\quad c\leftarrow v_m,\quad S\leftarrow S+J_m$; **end for**. |
| 12 | **Return** $dc$. |
